components.name: Sidebar
components.description:
Sidebar

The sidebar panel. In the Narrow tier (below `md`) it renders as a Sheet
drawer; at or above `md` it docks to the chosen `side` and collapses per the
`collapsible` mode.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Collapse behaviour: slide `offcanvas`, shrink to an `icon` rail, or `none`.

props.name: side
props.description: Which edge the sidebar docks to.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual treatment: flush `sidebar`, detached `floating`, or `inset` (pairs
with `SidebarInset` for a card-like main region).

components.name: SidebarContent
components.description:
SidebarContent

The sidebar's scrollable nav region holding its groups and menus. Renders as a
`<nav>` landmark, named via `aria-label` (default "Sidebar"), so assistive tech
can jump to it — pass a distinct `aria-label` when a page has more than one
navigation. Hides overflow when collapsed to the icon rail.

components.name: SidebarFooter
components.description:
SidebarFooter

Bottom region of the sidebar — typically a user menu or sign-out control.

components.name: SidebarGroup
components.description:
SidebarGroup

A labelled section of the sidebar, grouping related menu items.

components.name: SidebarGroupAction
components.description:
SidebarGroupAction

A small action button pinned to a group's top-right (e.g. "add" next to a
group label). Hidden when collapsed to the icon rail.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element via Radix `Slot`.

components.name: SidebarGroupContent
components.description:
SidebarGroupContent

Wrapper for the body of a `SidebarGroup` (usually a `SidebarMenu`).

components.name: SidebarGroupLabel
components.description:
SidebarGroupLabel

The heading above a `SidebarGroup`. Fades out when the sidebar collapses to
the icon rail.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element via Radix `Slot` (e.g. an accessible heading).

components.name: SidebarHeader
components.description:
SidebarHeader

Top region of the sidebar — typically the brand mark or a workspace switcher.

components.name: SidebarInput
components.description:
SidebarInput

An `Input` pre-styled to sit inside the sidebar (e.g. a filter field).

components.name: SidebarInset
components.description:
SidebarInset

The main content region beside the sidebar. With `variant="inset"` it floats
as a rounded card; otherwise it fills the remaining width. `min-w-0` lets a
wide child (e.g. a data table) scroll inside its own container instead of
forcing the inset — and the page — wider than the viewport.

components.name: SidebarMenu
components.description:
SidebarMenu

The `<ul>` holding a group's navigation items.

components.name: SidebarMenuAction
components.description:
SidebarMenuAction

A secondary action pinned to a menu item's right edge (e.g. a "more" button).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element via Radix `Slot`.

props.name: showOnHover
props.description: Reveal the action only on hover/focus of the menu item (vs. always shown).

components.name: SidebarMenuBadge
components.description:
SidebarMenuBadge

A count or status pill aligned to a menu item's right edge.

components.name: SidebarMenuButton
components.description:
SidebarMenuButton

The primary clickable nav item. When the sidebar collapses to icons, an
optional `tooltip` surfaces the label on hover.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element via Radix `Slot` (e.g. an `<a>` or router link).

props.name: isActive
props.description: Marks the item as the current page; styles it as selected.

props.name: tooltip
props.description:
Tooltip shown only when the sidebar is collapsed to the icon rail. Pass a
string for label-only, or `TooltipContent` props for full control.

components.name: SidebarMenuItem
components.description:
SidebarMenuItem

A single `<li>` in a `SidebarMenu`; wraps a `SidebarMenuButton` plus optional
action/badge/sub-menu.

components.name: SidebarMenuSkeleton
components.description:
SidebarMenuSkeleton

Loading placeholder for a menu row. Render a cluster while nav data loads.

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Render a leading icon-sized skeleton block alongside the text bar.

components.name: SidebarMenuSub
components.description:
SidebarMenuSub

The `<ul>` for a nested submenu, drawn with a left guide rule. Hidden when
collapsed to the icon rail.

components.name: SidebarMenuSubButton
components.description:
SidebarMenuSubButton

A clickable item inside a submenu, rendered as an `<a>` by default.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element via Radix `Slot` (e.g. a router link).

props.name: isActive
props.description: Marks the sub-item as the current page; styles it as selected.

props.name: size
props.description: Text size of the sub-item.

components.name: SidebarMenuSubItem
components.description:
SidebarMenuSubItem

A single `<li>` within a `SidebarMenuSub`.

components.name: SidebarProvider
components.description:
SidebarProvider

Owns the sidebar's open state, the `Ctrl/Cmd+B` keyboard shortcut, and cookie
persistence. Wrap your app shell in it; every sidebar part reads its context.
Renders a `TooltipProvider` so collapsed-icon tooltips work out of the box.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
Whether the sidebar starts open when uncontrolled.

When uncontrolled, the provider persists the open state to a `sidebar_state`
cookie. It does not read the cookie back — restore across reloads by reading
it server-side and passing the result here.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes (in controlled mode).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Pair with `onOpenChange` to control externally.

components.name: SidebarRail
components.description:
SidebarRail

Thin hit-target along the sidebar's inner edge that toggles it on click —
a quick affordance for collapsing/expanding without leaving the panel.

components.name: SidebarSeparator
components.description:
SidebarSeparator

A `Separator` inset to align with the sidebar's content padding.

components.name: SidebarTrigger
components.description:
SidebarTrigger

Icon button that toggles the sidebar. Place it in your top bar or sidebar
header. Also reachable via `Ctrl/Cmd+B`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
When true, the button renders as its child element (via Radix Slot),
applying button styling to e.g. an `<a>` while leaving the child's own
content untouched — compose icons inside the child. `loading` and the
`startIcon` / `endIcon` slots apply to the native `<button>` only.

props.name: endIcon
props.description:
Decorative icon rendered after the button label. Use either `endIcon`
or `startIcon`, not both. Hidden while `loading` (the spinner replaces all
content).

props.name: loading
props.description:
Shows a loading indicator and disables the button. While loading, the
spinner replaces all visible content and any icon slots are hidden.

props.name: startIcon
props.description:
Decorative icon rendered before the button label. Use either `startIcon`
or `endIcon`, not both. Hidden while `loading` (the spinner replaces all
content).
